resources.string: Choose what the Exit command deletes

Exit stops playback and downloads, closes all browser windows and deletes the selected data from the regular profile for all time. Nothing is selected by default. Bookmarks, extensions and browser and homepage settings are retained. The existing Close tabs on exit setting controls whether regular tabs can be restored on your next launch.\n\nMinimizing, turning the screen off, pausing playback and reaching its time limit do not run Exit or its cleanup. Background playback does not prevent the explicit Exit command. Removing a window from Recents is not this command.
